prompts: A policy newsletter is running a piece on which of Brazil's anti-inflation plans delivered what it promised, and wants a ranking it can defend. Research the plans in {WS}/RUBRIC.md on the open web: this one needs public sources, and you are allowed to browse. Score every plan with that rubric, rank the top 3, and write a one-page dossier for the editor in {WS}/dossier.md. Every number must carry the URL it came from. Record the result in {WS}/result.json: plans (one entry per plan with plan, launch_date, ipca_before, ipca_after, months_lasted, score and sources, a list of URLs) and top3 (plan names, best first).
answers:
[goal] Rank the plans using the supplied rubric.

[action] Created [dossier.md](dossier.md) and [result.json](result.json), with sources and assumptions.

[result] Real, Collor I and Collor II rank highest. The scores use IBGE’s annual IPCA series and the Central Bank’s month-level chronology. An independent calculation returned `True` for all six recorded scores.

[next] The dossier flags the ranking’s main limit: the rubric measures a proxy, not each plan’s causal effect or fulfillment of every promise.

--- dossier.md ---
# Editor dossier: Brazil's anti-inflation plans

**Ranking under the supplied rubric:** Real, Collor I, Collor II. Real is the clear winner: annual IPCA fell from [2,477.15%](https://www.ibge.gov.br/biblioteca/visualizacao/periodicos/236/inpc_ipca_2012_jan.pdf) in the preceding year to [22.41%](https://www.ibge.gov.br/biblioteca/visualizacao/periodicos/236/inpc_ipca_2012_jan.pdf) in the following year. Collor I also shows a large measured decline; Collor II scores third partly because the rubric assigns it the interval until Real.

This ranks the specified proxy, not proof that each plan alone caused the change or fulfilled every promise. The comparison uses full calendar years, so it includes other policies and economic events; the next-plan interval is a proxy for durability, not proof the measures remained effective throughout.

| Plan | Launch | IPCA before → after (%) | Months | Score |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Real | [1994-02](https://www.bcb.gov.br/conteudo/depec/NotasTecnicas/Nota_tecnica_49.pdf) | [2,477.15 → 22.41](https://www.ibge.gov.br/biblioteca/visualizacao/periodicos/236/inpc_ipca_2012_jan.pdf) | [60](https://www.bcb.gov.br/conteudo/depec/NotasTecnicas/Nota_tecnica_49.pdf) | [0.993667](https://www.ibge.gov.br/biblioteca/visualizacao/periodicos/236/inpc_ipca_2012_jan.pdf) |
| Collor I | [1990-03](https://www.bcb.gov.br/conteudo/depec/NotasTecnicas/Nota_tecnica_49.pdf) | [1,972.91 → 472.70](https://www.ibge.gov.br/biblioteca/visualizacao/periodicos/236/inpc_ipca_2012_jan.pdf) | [10](https://www.bcb.gov.br/conteudo/depec/NotasTecnicas/Nota_tecnica_49.pdf) | [0.582283](https://www.ibge.gov.br/biblioteca/visualizacao/periodicos/236/inpc_ipca_2012_jan.pdf) |
| Collor II | [1991-01](https://www.bcb.gov.br/conteudo/depec/NotasTecnicas/Nota_tecnica_49.pdf) | [1,620.97 → 1,119.10](https://www.ibge.gov.br/biblioteca/visualizacao/periodicos/236/inpc_ipca_2012_jan.pdf) | [37](https://www.bcb.gov.br/conteudo/depec/NotasTecnicas/Nota_tecnica_49.pdf) | [0.401728](https://www.ibge.gov.br/biblioteca/visualizacao/periodicos/236/inpc_ipca_2012_jan.pdf) |
| Bresser | [1987-06](https://www.bcb.gov.br/conteudo/depec/NotasTecnicas/Nota_tecnica_49.pdf) | [79.66 → 980.21](https://www.ibge.gov.br/biblioteca/visualizacao/periodicos/236/inpc_ipca_2012_jan.pdf) | [19](https://www.bcb.gov.br/conteudo/depec/NotasTecnicas/Nota_tecnica_49.pdf) | [0.095000](https://www.ibge.gov.br/biblioteca/visualizacao/periodicos/236/inpc_ipca_2012_jan.pdf) |
| Cruzado | [1986-02](https://www.bcb.gov.br/conteudo/depec/NotasTecnicas/Nota_tecnica_49.pdf) | [242.23 → 363.41](https://www.ibge.gov.br/biblioteca/visualizacao/periodicos/236/inpc_ipca_2012_jan.pdf) | [16](https://www.bcb.gov.br/conteudo/depec/NotasTecnicas/Nota_tecnica_49.pdf) | [0.080000](https://www.ibge.gov.br/biblioteca/visualizacao/periodicos/236/inpc_ipca_2012_jan.pdf) |
| Verão | [1989-01](https://www.bcb.gov.br/conteudo/depec/NotasTecnicas/Nota_tecnica_49.pdf) | [980.21 → 1,620.97](https://www.ibge.gov.br/biblioteca/visualizacao/periodicos/236/inpc_ipca_2012_jan.pdf) | [14](https://www.bcb.gov.br/conteudo/depec/NotasTecnicas/Nota_tecnica_49.pdf) | [0.070000](https://www.ibge.gov.br/biblioteca/visualizacao/periodicos/236/inpc_ipca_2012_jan.pdf) |

The launch dates are month precision, as published in the [Central Bank chronology](https://www.bcb.gov.br/conteudo/depec/NotasTecnicas/Nota_tecnica_49.pdf); month differences count whole calendar months between those months. Real is treated as beginning with the phased plan in February, rather than the later currency introduction. Real's duration is the rubric's fixed cap, not an observed end date. The chronology includes intervening plans, but intervals follow the specific successors named in the rubric. Annual rates are the [IBGE historical series](https://www.ibge.gov.br/biblioteca/visualizacao/periodicos/236/inpc_ipca_2012_jan.pdf).

Scores are calculated from the supplied rubric using unrounded inputs and displayed to six decimal places. Score
